# SC-02: An email with no readable purchase order goes to the exceptions list

## Steps
1. Send the 2 test emails, each with an image instead of a PDF, to the orders mailbox.
2. Open the exceptions list and the order sheet copy.

## Expected result
Both emails are on the exceptions list with the reason, and nothing is written to the order sheet (2 cases).
